segments.source: O NCE Raven went to Ground-hog’s house for the winter.
Now Ground-hogs go into their holes in September.
At home they live like people.
So Raven spent the winter with Ground-hog and became very tired of it.
But he could not get out.
Ground-hog enjoyed himself, but Raven acted like a prisoner.
Raven thought that Ground-hog had power to shorten the winter.
Now at that time, Ground-hog had to stay in his hole for six months; at that time, Ground-hog had six toes, one for each month of winter.
Then Raven pulled one toe off each foot, so that the winter would be shorter.
That is why the Ground-hog now has but five toes.
